verdict.rationale: Postman's docs say teams can create internal workspaces where members share, version, and discuss their work [postman-docs-18], and that workspaces let you collaborate with teammates [postman-docs-21]. Roles and permissions can be set at team, workspace, and element level [postman-docs-14], and live sessions add real-time collaboration [postman-docs-13]. A community report of collections being restored within a team workspace indirectly confirms cloud-hosted shared collections [postman-comm-8]; the 2014 wish for live sharing [postman-comm-20] predates these docs and does not contradict them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that collections auto-sync across teammates' clients, and independent hands-on corroboration of synced collection sharing.
